contents.reason: Upper crystal bases are the bar-conjugate companion of the lower bases and are needed only in the globalization/balanced-triple comparison; that construction is owned by the QG-5 page, which is the planned destination of this item.

contents.reason: The uniqueness theorem and the decomposition of a crystal basis into highest weight components are the content of the QG-4 page (its item thm-crystal-bases-of-integrable-modules-decompose-into-highest-weight-crystals), which is the planned destination; this page proves only existence and the projection compatibility.

contents.reason: The library replaces Kashiwara's abstract reduced algebra by the equivalent skew-derivation presentation $e_i',e_i''$ of the negative half, which is already built and proved on the QG-2 page; using the reduced algebra as well would duplicate that machinery without adding mathematical content.

contents.reason: The skew derivations, the separation statement and the existence/non-degeneracy of the ``Lusztig-Kashiwara form'' on the negative half are built and recorded on the QG-2 page; this page consumes them.

contents.reason: Polarization and the global (canonical) bases belong to the QG-5 page, which owns the balanced-triple and globalization construction and is the planned destination.

contents.name: §7 Proofs of Theorems 6 and 7
